mkdir -p /tmp/rpc-probe && cd /tmp/rpc-probe && cat > probe.py <<'EOF'
import subprocess, json, time, select, os, signal, uuid, sys
p = subprocess.Popen(["droid","exec","--input-format","stream-jsonrpc","--output-format","stream-jsonrpc","--cwd","/tmp/rpc-probe"],
    stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=open("/tmp/rpc-probe/stderr.log","wb"), start_new_session=True)
def send(o):
    p.stdin.write((json.dumps(o)+"\n").encode()); p.stdin.flush()
base={"type":"request","jsonrpc":"2.0","factoryApiVersion":"1.0.0"}
send({**base,"id":"1","method":"droid.initialize_session","params":{"machineId":str(uuid.uuid4()),"cwd":"/tmp/rpc-probe","autonomyLevel":"off"}})
t0=time.time(); out=[]
sent_int=False
while time.time()-t0<20:
    r,_,_=select.select([p.stdout],[],[],0.5)
    if r:
        l=p.stdout.readline()
        if not l: break
        out.append(l.decode()); print(l.decode()[:1500],end="")
        if not sent_int and '"id":"1"' in l.decode():
            send({**base,"id":"2","method":"droid.interrupt_session","params":{}}); sent_int=True
os.killpg(p.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
print("LINES",len(out))
EOF
timeout 40 python3 probe.py; echo ---; cat stderr.log | head -20
